notes: Recruitment (NP_08 s2). Winning a dual flags the recruitable named fighters of the squad you beat (up to 4, NP_08 s2.1's 2-4; a non-boss recruit surfaces 'with' the boss whose club he belongs to) as APPROACHABLE; approaching one surfaces the whole condition, every clause with what you have and what it needs (honest once discovered, no wiki-bait); when every clause is met the fighter is READY, and recruiting him puts his card in the stable - dressable on a board, written by the save. Nobody auto-joins: a met condition raises an event, the recruit is your call. The grammar (NP_08 s2.2) is executed in full: six forms read the sim's own ledgers (BEAT_IN counts your wins against that fighter by size - scrap, spar, dual[segment] - and xN asks N of them; USING STYLE_PROOF(style) asks them won with a fighter of that style; PI_LEVEL reads the recon ledger, his page counting as 3; BOND(stablemate, n) asks that stablemate's best Kizuna in the stable at level n; STAT_PROOF asks a stablemate with the stat; WITNESS counts duals won after he was approached - the greybox has one venue, the Old Gym), and five read the story flags the overworld sets (QUEST, REP, FEUD_RESOLVED, BLESSING, ITEM: flags nobody in the sim sets; the greybox seeds them with `-- flag=`; since PAC-101 REP is the sim's - the district rep ledger, a seeded rep flag still counting). Conditions are the roster docs' own lines, quoted with their source; the readings (Yuri's and Sam's 'recruited post-dual' as BEAT_IN(dual[segment]), Dex's whole line) and the new cards (the boss's META style / element / House, the assembler's tier-3 stat block, his desperation move or a drafted one) are first drafts. Bosses the docs close - none, staff, post-game, unauthored - carry the reason and are never approachable. Jean-Guy declines in Arc 1 (NP_04A s5, kept as his arc1 line) and recruits in Arc 2 through Q-MOREAU (NP_07A); the String Wall (string_wall.v1.json) reveals whom a recruit brings. A record may carry `around_the_family`: a second condition that signs him before his house blesses the club - he arrives UNSANCTIONED (houses.v1.json); Efua's is the only one the docs author.

BEAT_IN.text: beat them in a scrap / spar / dual segment (xN: N times; USING STYLE_PROOF(style): with a fighter of that style)

STYLE_PROOF.text: beat them with a fighter of that style

PI_LEVEL.text: Pattern Intel on that House's dialect at that level

BOND.text: that stablemate's best Kizuna in the stable at that level

WITNESS.text: a dual won after they were approached (they watch it)

REP.text: the district's rep on the ledger at that level (PAC-101: scraps won there, a flee's cost; a seeded rep:<district> flag still counts)
